meta.objective: Analyze the first clean pass of the full 20-cell V4 headline matrix, summarize the most important geometry/provider findings, and define the monitored rerun or promotion policy for follow-on launch work.

decisions.statement: Treat the first clean headline pass as analyzable signal, not just smoke. The matrix is coherent enough to drive targeted rerun decisions without another full blind repeat.
Zheng tie suppression now appears robust across the full provider panel because all four baseline providers produced zero ties on the 13-item slice.

The current abstention intervention is not behaviorally active on this matrix: zero abstains across 392 responses means further exact repeats of the entire abstention panel are lower priority than targeted reruns on cells that actually moved.
Promote a targeted rerun cohort rather than a full-matrix repeat: Gilardi baseline/l2 for GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, and Qwen; Zheng baseline/abstention for GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, and Qwen.
